subject: general
question: If (x-(1)/(x)=4), then what is the value of (x⁶+(1)/(x⁶)) ?
solution:
**Given:**

(x-(1)/(x)=4)

**Formula used:**

(x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2

(xⁿ + 1/xⁿ) identity method

**Calculations:**

(x-(1)/(x)=4)

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 4²

⇒ x² + 1/x² − 2 = 16

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 18

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 18²

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 324 − 2 = 322

⇒ (x² + 1/x²) × (x⁴ + 1/x⁴) = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ + x² + 1/x²

⇒ 18 × 322 = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ + 18

⇒ x⁶ + 1/x⁶ = 5796 − 18 = 5778

**∴ The value of x⁶ + 1/x⁶ = 5778.**
